title: Galaxy Digital plans to launch a hedge fund in Q1 2026 investing up to 30% in crypto tokens and the rest in financial stocks; sources say it has raised $100M (Nikou Asgari/Financial Times)
summary: Nikou Asgari / Financial Times: Galaxy Digital plans to launch a hedge fund in Q1 2026 investing up to 30% in crypto tokens and the rest in financial stocks; sources say it has raised $100M — Billionaire's firm plans portfolio to profit from rising and falling prices, following sharp sell-off in digital assets sector
